verses.original: λελάληκα ὑμῖν Ταῦτα ἵνα μὴ σκανδαλισθῆτε
verses.transliteration: lelalēka hymin Tauta hina mē skandalisthēte
verses.literal: I have told you these things so that vvv you will not fall away

verses.original: ποιήσουσιν ὑμᾶς ἀποσυναγώγους ἀλλ’ ὥρα ἔρχεται ἵνα πᾶς ὁ ἀποκτείνας ὑμᾶς δόξῃ προσφέρειν λατρείαν τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: poiēsousin hymas aposynagōgous all’ hōra erchetai hina pas ho apokteinas hymas doxē prospherein latreian tō Theō
verses.literal: They will put you out of the synagogues In fact a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering a service - to God

verses.original: καὶ ποιήσουσιν ταῦτα ὅτι ἔγνωσαν οὐκ τὸν Πατέρα οὐδὲ ἐμέ
verses.transliteration: kai poiēsousin tauta hoti egnōsan ouk ton Patera oude eme
verses.literal: - They will do these things because they have not known - the Father [or] Me

verses.original: ἀλλὰ λελάληκα ὑμῖν ταῦτα ἵνα ὅταν αὐτῶν ἡ ὥρα ἔλθῃ μνημονεύητε ὅτι ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν αὐτῶν δὲ οὐκ εἶπον ὑμῖν ταῦτα ἐξ ἀρχῆς ὅτι ἤμην μεθ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: alla lelalēka hymin tauta hina hotan autōn hē hōra elthē mnēmoneuēte hoti egō eipon hymin autōn de ouk eipon hymin tauta ex archēs hoti ēmēn meth’ hymōn
verses.literal: But I have told you these things so that when their - hour comes you will remember that I told you [about] them - vvv I did not tell you these things from [the] beginning because I was with you

verses.original: Νῦν δὲ ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πέμψαντά με καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐρωτᾷ με Ποῦ ὑπάγεις
verses.transliteration: Nyn de hypagō pros ton pempsanta me kai oudeis ex hymōn erōta me Pou hypageis
verses.literal: Now however I am going to Him who sent Me yet none of you asks Me Where are You going

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ὑμῶν τὴν καρδίαν πεπλήρωκεν ἡ λύπη ὅτι λελάληκα ὑμῖν ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: all’ hymōn tēn kardian peplērōken hē lypē hoti lelalēka hymin tauta
verses.literal: Instead your - hearts are filled - with sorrow because I have told you these things

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν τὴν ἀλήθειαν συμφέρει ὑμῖν ἵνα ἐγὼ ἀπέλθω γὰρ ἐὰν μὴ ἀπέλθω ὁ Παράκλητος οὐ μὴ ἔλθῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς δὲ ἐὰν πορευθῶ πέμψω αὐτὸν πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: all’ egō legō hymin tēn alētheian sympherei hymin hina egō apelthō gar ean mē apelthō ho Paraklētos ou mē elthē pros hymas de ean poreuthō pempsō auton pros hymas
verses.literal: But I tell you the truth it is for your benefit . . . that I am going away - Unless . . . I go away the Advocate vvv vvv will not come to you but if I go I will send Him to you

verses.original: Καὶ ἐλθὼν ἐκεῖνος ἐλέγξει τὸν κόσμον περὶ ἁμαρτίας καὶ περὶ δικαιοσύνης καὶ περὶ κρίσεως
verses.transliteration: Kai elthōn ekeinos elenxei ton kosmon peri hamartias kai peri dikaiosynēs kai peri kriseōs
verses.literal: And [when] He comes He will convict the world in regard to sin and - righteousness and - judgment

verses.original: περὶ ἁμαρτίας μέν ὅτι οὐ πιστεύουσιν εἰς ἐμέ
verses.transliteration: peri hamartias men hoti ou pisteuousin eis eme
verses.literal: in regard to sin - because vvv they do not believe in Me

verses.original: δέ περὶ δικαιοσύνης ὅτι ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα καὶ θεωρεῖτέ οὐκέτι με
verses.transliteration: de peri dikaiosynēs hoti hypagō pros ton Patera kai theōreite ouketi me
verses.literal: - in regard to righteousness because I am going to the Father and you will no longer see . . . Me

verses.original: δὲ περὶ κρίσεως ὅτι ὁ ἄρχων τούτου τοῦ κόσμου κέκριται
verses.transliteration: de peri kriseōs hoti ho archōn toutou tou kosmou kekritai
verses.literal: and in regard to judgment because the prince of this - world has been condemned

verses.original: Ἔτι ἔχω πολλὰ λέγειν ὑμῖν ἀλλ’ οὐ δύνασθε ἄρτι βαστάζειν
verses.transliteration: Eti echō polla legein hymin all’ ou dynasthe arti bastazein
verses.literal: vvv I still have much to tell you but vvv you cannot yet bear [to hear it]

verses.original: δὲ ὅταν ἐκεῖνος τὸ Πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας ἔλθῃ ὁδηγήσει ὑμᾶς ἐν πάσῃ τῇ ἀληθείᾳ γὰρ οὐ λαλήσει ἀφ’ ἑαυτοῦ ἀλλ’ λαλήσει ὅσα ἀκούσει καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν τὰ ἐρχόμενα
verses.transliteration: de hotan ekeinos to Pneuma tēs alētheias elthē hodēgēsei hymas en pasē tē alētheia gar ou lalēsei aph’ heautou all’ lalēsei hosa akousei kai anangelei hymin ta erchomena
verses.literal: However when - the Spirit - of truth comes He will guide you into all - truth For vvv He will not speak on His own but He will speak what He hears and He will declare to you what is to come

verses.original: ἐκεῖνος δοξάσει ἐμὲ ὅτι λήμψεται ἐκ τοῦ ἐμοῦ καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: ekeinos doxasei eme hoti lēmpsetai ek tou emou kai anangelei hymin
verses.literal: He will glorify Me - by taking from what [is] Mine and disclosing [it] to you

verses.original: πάντα ὅσα ἔχει ὁ Πατὴρ ἐστιν ἐμά διὰ τοῦτο εἶπον ὅτι λαμβάνει ἐκ τοῦ ἐμοῦ καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: panta hosa echei ho Patēr estin ema dia touto eipon hoti lambanei ek tou emou kai anangelei hymin
verses.literal: Everything that belongs to the Father is Mine That is why . . . I said that [the Spirit] will take from what [is] Mine and disclose [it] to you

verses.original: Μικρὸν καὶ θεωρεῖτέ με οὐκέτι καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με
verses.transliteration: Mikron kai theōreite me ouketi kai palin mikron kai opsesthe me
verses.literal: In a little [while] . . . you will see Me no more and then after a little [while] . . . you will see Me

verses.original: οὖν ἐκ αὐτοῦ τῶν μαθητῶν Εἶπαν πρὸς ἀλλήλους Τί ἐστιν τοῦτο ὃ λέγει ἡμῖν Μικρὸν καὶ οὐ θεωρεῖτέ με καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με καί Ὅτι ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα
verses.transliteration: oun ek autou tōn mathētōn Eipan pros allēlous Ti estin touto ho legei hēmin Mikron kai ou theōreite me kai palin mikron kai opsesthe me kai Hoti hypagō pros ton Patera
verses.literal: Then [some] of His - disciples asked . . . one another Why is - - He telling us In a little [while] . . . vvv you will not see Me and then after a little [while] . . . you will see Me and Because I am going to the Father

verses.original: οὖν ἔλεγον τί ἐστιν Τοῦτο ὃ λέγει Τὸ μικρόν οὐκ οἴδαμεν τί λαλεῖ
verses.transliteration: oun elegon ti estin Touto ho legei To mikron ouk oidamen ti lalei
verses.literal: - They kept asking Why is - - He saying a little [while] vvv We do not understand what He is saying

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς Ἔγνω ὁ ὅτι ἤθελον ἐρωτᾶν αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ζητεῖτε μετ’ ἀλλήλων Περὶ τούτου ὅτι εἶπον Μικρὸν καὶ οὐ θεωρεῖτέ με καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με
verses.transliteration: Iēsous Egnō ho hoti ēthelon erōtan auton kai eipen autois zēteite met’ allēlōn Peri toutou hoti eipon Mikron kai ou theōreite me kai palin mikron kai opsesthe me
verses.literal: - Aware - that they wanted to question Him - [Jesus] said to them Are you asking vvv one another why . . . - I said In a little [while] . . . vvv you will not see Me and then after a little [while] . . . you will see Me

verses.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὑμεῖς κλαύσετε καὶ θρηνήσετε δὲ ὁ κόσμος χαρήσεται ὑμεῖς λυπηθήσεσθε ἀλλ’ ὑμῶν ἡ λύπη γενήσεται εἰς χαρὰν
verses.transliteration: amēn amēn legō hymin hoti hymeis klausete kai thrēnēsete de ho kosmos charēsetai hymeis lypēthēsesthe all’ hymōn hē lypē genēsetai eis charan
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you - you will weep and wail [while] the world rejoices You will grieve but your - grief will turn to joy

verses.original: ἡ γυνὴ ἔχει λύπην ὅταν τίκτῃ ὅτι αὐτῆς ἡ ὥρα ἦλθεν δὲ ὅταν γεννήσῃ τὸ παιδίον μνημονεύει οὐκέτι τῆς θλίψεως διὰ τὴν χαρὰν ὅτι ἄνθρωπος ἐγεννήθη εἰς τὸν κόσμον
verses.transliteration: hē gynē echei lypēn hotan tiktē hoti autēs hē hōra ēlthen de hotan gennēsē to paidion mnēmoneuei ouketi tēs thlipseōs dia tēn charan hoti anthrōpos egennēthē eis ton kosmon
verses.literal: - A woman has pain vvv in childbirth because her - time has come but when she brings forth [her] child she forgets . . . [her] anguish because of [her] joy that a child has been born into the world

verses.original: οὖν καὶ μὲν ὑμεῖς ἔχετε λύπην νῦν δὲ ὄψομαι ὑμᾶς πάλιν καὶ ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία χαρήσεται καὶ οὐδεὶς αἴρει ἀφ’ ὑμῶν ὑμῶν τὴν χαρὰν
verses.transliteration: oun kai men hymeis echete lypēn nyn de opsomai hymas palin kai hymōn hē kardia charēsetai kai oudeis airei aph’ hymōn hymōn tēn charan
verses.literal: So also - you have sorrow now but I will see you again and your - hearts will rejoice and no one will take away - your - joy

verses.original: Καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐρωτήσετε ἐμὲ οὐκ οὐδέν ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἄν τι αἰτήσητε τὸν Πατέρα ἐν μου τῷ ὀνόματί δώσει ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Kai en ekeinē tē hēmera erōtēsete eme ouk ouden amēn amēn legō hymin an ti aitēsēte ton Patera en mou tō onomati dōsei hymin
verses.literal: - In that - day you will {no longer} ask Me vvv [anything] Truly truly I tell you vvv whatever you ask the Father in My - name He will give you

verses.original: ἕως ἄρτι ᾐτήσατε οὐκ οὐδὲν ἐν μου τῷ ὀνόματί αἰτεῖτε καὶ λήμψεσθε ἵνα ὑμῶν ἡ χαρὰ ᾖ πεπληρωμένη
verses.transliteration: heōs arti ētēsate ouk ouden en mou tō onomati aiteite kai lēmpsesthe hina hymōn hē chara ē peplērōmenē
verses.literal: Until now you have not asked vvv [for anything] in My - name Ask and you will receive so that your - joy may be complete

verses.original: λελάληκα Ταῦτα ὑμῖν ἐν παροιμίαις ὥρα ἔρχεται ὅτε λαλήσω οὐκέτι ὑμῖν ἐν παροιμίαις ἀλλὰ ἀπαγγελῶ ὑμῖν παρρησίᾳ περὶ τοῦ Πατρὸς
verses.transliteration: lelalēka Tauta hymin en paroimiais hōra erchetai hote lalēsō ouketi hymin en paroimiais alla apangelō hymin parrēsia peri tou Patros
verses.literal: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech An hour is coming when I will no longer speak . . . to you vvv [this way] but will tell you plainly about the Father

verses.original: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ αἰτήσεσθε ἐν μου τῷ ὀνόματί καὶ οὐ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐρωτήσω τὸν Πατέρα περὶ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: en ekeinē tē hēmera aitēsesthe en mou tō onomati kai ou legō hymin hoti egō erōtēsō ton Patera peri hymōn
verses.literal: In that - day you will ask in My - name - vvv I am not saying - that I will ask the Father on your behalf

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ Πατὴρ αὐτὸς φιλεῖ ὑμᾶς ὅτι ὑμεῖς πεφιλήκατε ἐμὲ καὶ πεπιστεύκατε ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐξῆλθον παρὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar ho Patēr autos philei hymas hoti hymeis pephilēkate eme kai pepisteukate hoti egō exēlthon para tou Theou
verses.literal: For the Father Himself loves you because you have loved Me and have believed that I came from - God

verses.original: ἐξῆλθον ἐκ τοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ ἐλήλυθα εἰς τὸν κόσμον πάλιν ἀφίημι τὸν κόσμον καὶ πορεύομαι πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα
verses.transliteration: exēlthon ek tou Patros kai elēlytha eis ton kosmon palin aphiēmi ton kosmon kai poreuomai pros ton Patera
verses.literal: I came from the Father and entered . . . the world In turn I will leave the world and go to the Father

verses.original: αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ Λέγουσιν Ἴδε νῦν λαλεῖς ἐν παρρησίᾳ καὶ οὐδεμίαν λέγεις παροιμίαν
verses.transliteration: autou hoi mathētai Legousin Ide nyn laleis en parrēsia kai oudemian legeis paroimian
verses.literal: His - disciples said See now You are speaking vvv plainly and without vvv figures of speech

verses.original: νῦν οἴδαμεν ὅτι οἶδας πάντα καὶ ἔχεις οὐ χρείαν ἵνα τίς ἐρωτᾷ σε ἐν τούτῳ πιστεύομεν ὅτι ἐξῆλθες ἀπὸ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: nyn oidamen hoti oidas panta kai echeis ou chreian hina tis erōta se en toutō pisteuomen hoti exēlthes apo Theou
verses.literal: Now we understand that You know all things and that You have no need for anyone to question You Because of this we believe that You came from God

verses.original: Ἄρτι πιστεύετε Ἰησοῦς Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Arti pisteuete Iēsous Apekrithē autois
verses.literal: vvv Do you finally believe Jesus replied . . .

verses.original: ἰδοὺ ὥρα ἔρχεται καὶ ἐλήλυθεν ἵνα σκορπισθῆτε ἕκαστος εἰς τὰ ἴδια ἀφῆτε κἀμὲ μόνον καὶ εἰμὶ οὐκ μόνος ὅτι ὁ Πατὴρ ἐστιν μετ’ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: idou hōra erchetai kai elēlythen hina skorpisthēte hekastos eis ta idia aphēte kame monon kai eimi ouk monos hoti ho Patēr estin met’ emou
verses.literal: Look an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered each to [his] own [home] {and} you will leave Me all alone Yet I am not alone because the Father is with Me

verses.original: λελάληκα ὑμῖν ταῦτα ἵνα ἐν ἐμοὶ ἔχητε εἰρήνην ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἔχετε θλῖψιν ἀλλὰ θαρσεῖτε ἐγὼ νενίκηκα τὸν κόσμον
verses.transliteration: lelalēka hymin tauta hina en emoi echēte eirēnēn en tō kosmō echete thlipsin alla tharseite egō nenikēka ton kosmon
verses.literal: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace In the world you will have tribulation But take courage I have overcome the world
